⚠️ Important update,

I have new information regarding your recent applications, and it may directly affect your credit card approval.
Take a moment to review the next steps.

👇 When you're ready, choose your next step below:

📬 UNCLAIMED PACKAGE. A Credit Card package worth £14,200 in limit is sitting unclaimed under your name.

It's at the sorting center. Claim the delivery before it gets returned.

💳 CREDIT CARD APPROVED

Congratulations! Your new Credit Card is ready for dispatch.

We just need you to confirm the delivery address.

💳 CARD REVIEW UPDATE

Your card request has a review step ready. Open the page to continue with the available options.

📋 CARD REQUEST STATUS

A status check is available for your card profile. Review the details before moving forward.

✅ CARD OPTIONS READY

Your card options are ready to compare. Open the update and confirm the next step.

🔎 CARD REVIEW AVAILABLE

The card recommendation flow has new details available. Check the page to continue.

📌 APPLICATION STEP READY

Your profile review is ready for confirmation. Open the card update to see the result.

📦 PACKAGE UPDATE: your Credit Card package is sealed and labeled.

The mailman is scheduled for tomorrow. But we still need your delivery confirmation to dispatch it.

🔔 CARD MATCH UPDATE

A card selection step is available now. Review the page and continue from there.

📄 REVIEW STEP OPEN

Your card request moved to the next review point. Open the status page for details.

🔔 (1) CARD UPDATE

Your Credit Card request has a new status available.

Tap below to review the next step.

🏠 HOME DELIVERY OPTION

Home delivery is available for your Credit Card package.

Confirm your address to move forward.

📦 READY FOR DISPATCH

Your Credit Card package is ready for dispatch.

Confirm the details so it can move forward.

💬 CARD PROFILE UPDATE

The card option summary is ready. Confirm the information on the review page.

⚡ CARD DISPATCHED. No waiting. Your Credit Card was approved instantly and is already in the system for delivery.

Tap to assign the courier and receive it today.

💳 CARD OPTION NOTICE

A new card profile update is available. Check the options and continue safely.

✅ AUTHORIZED: you are cleared to activate your new card.

No more waiting. Tap to start.

🔔 (1) NEW CARD UPDATE

Your Credit Card status has changed to: APPROVED.

Tap to see your starting limit and shipping date.

📋 CARD STATUS READY

Your card match has an available result. Open the update to review the details.
